mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox_event (tenant_id, outbox_id, message_id, publication_key, business_intent_key, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, contract_ref, contract_version, body_bytes, body_sha256, correlation_id, causation_id, status, attempt_count, next_attempt_at, locked_by, locked_at, last_error_code, broker_confirmed_at, lock_version, created_at, created_by_type, created_by_id, updated_at, updated_by_type, updated_by_id) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{outboxId}, #{messageId}, #{publicationKey}, #{businessIntentKey}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{contractRef}, #{contractVersion}, #{bodyBytes}, #{bodySha256}, #{correlationId}, #{causationId}, 'PENDING', 0, #{createdAt}, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 0, #{createdAt}, 'SERVICE', NULL, #{createdAt}, 'SERVICE', NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM outbox_event WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND publication_key=#{publicationKey} AND aggregate_type='NOTIFICATION_REQUEST' AND aggregate_id=#{sourceRefId}
